## Goal

Complete T-0094 view-count principle tier analysis and document findings

## Summary

Completed T-0094 view-count principle across PyPI popularity and age tiers experiment. Key finding: G1_ratio = 1.0 in all 9 tier-subgroups (3 popularity × 3 age), meaning need-related packages have exactly equal active rates to random packages when popularity and age are controlled. This narrows the view-count principle's scope on PyPI: the previously validated activity advantage (E203, n=20 un-tiered) is not robust to these sub-factor controls. Produced 3 files: PROTOCOL.md (89 lines, pre-declared question/gates/design), RESULT.md (85 lines, gate results and interpretation), analysis.json (167 lines, committed raw analysis data). Experiment directory: EXPERIMENTS/T-0094-viewcount-pypi-tiers/. This is a 'fresh observation per D083' — a new axis of investigation within the existing view-count principle domain. No product claimed, no adoption claimed.

## Next

Review whether the view-count principle's narrowed scope on PyPI requires qualification of its general claim, or pivot to a new domain axis per D083
